summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing an on-market share buy-back, purchasing 340,000 ordinary shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on 7 August 2026 at a volume-weighted average price of HK$160.3335 per share, with total buy-back consideration of US$16.0 million since commencement on 5 August 2026. The repurchase is part of a previously announced buy-back and is conducted through BNP Paribas Financial Markets. Shares will be cancelled, reducing issued capital. The filing notes no UK venue repurchases and provides a link to individual trade details. The buy-back is routine capital return activity, with no premium, tender, or strategic restructuring; watch for continued repurchase pace and total consideration.
